head_after_note: The committed result JSON cannot contain its own final commit SHA without changing that SHA. The final response records the committed and remotely verified feature branch HEAD.
implementation_summary: Added shared PMBOT artifact root resolution so diagnostics and Telegram readers agree on PMBOT_ARTIFACT_DIR when it is configured, while keeping the repo-relative artifact default for tests and existing local flows.

Updated runtime credential visibility, funder wallet context, and live account read-only probe diagnostics to write under PMBOT_ARTIFACT_DIR/<diagnostic-subdir> unless an explicit artifact directory is provided.
Updated Telegram runtime/status loading so Connection reads the same runtime_credential_visibility_077c result/latest artifacts used by the CLI diagnostic.

Updated Connection fallback normalization so present API key, API secret, passphrase, private key, wallet address, signature type, and PMBOT_TELEGRAM_* aliases render connected individually, while a missing POLYMARKET_FUNDER_ADDRESS remains specifically not connected.

Updated Balance status rendering to distinguish missing credentials, missing funder, missing read-only account artifact, blocked_sdk_unavailable, and real read-only account artifact states without fake balances, PnL, orders, signing, or live trading.

artifact_resolution_contract.override_behavior: When PMBOT_ARTIFACT_DIR is set, diagnostics write and Telegram reads each artifact family from PMBOT_ARTIFACT_DIR/<artifact-family-dir>.
artifact_resolution_contract.explicit_artifact_dir_behavior: Existing explicit artifact_dir arguments remain exact output directories for backward compatibility.

remaining_risks: The runner smoke executed in the Codex process where Polymarket credentials were not visible, so it validates artifact path behavior and safe missing-credential states rather than a real credential-present local operator environment.
Read-only account balance still depends on a future successful official SDK probe artifact; the UI now labels blocked_sdk_unavailable separately and does not synthesize balances.
